narrative.overview: An Turas feels like opening a field journal beside an artifact: intimate, tactile, and precise, with the whole island just beyond the page. Every surface has one authored anchor. Image-led and text-led openings share the same editorial sequence, with live accessible copy, deliberate open space, and a native iOS interaction shell.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral, adaptive surfaces with high-contrast botanical accents.
Serif-led editorial moments inside a system-native interaction shell.
Evidence, uncertainty, and provenance made visible without production jargon.
Tactile feedback that is brief, physical, and optional under Reduce Motion.
Spacious reading views balanced by compact atlas and practice controls.
One dominant visual or typographic anchor with copy composed around it.

rules.name: The Evidence-Mark Rule
rules.body: Accent colors identify action, evidence type, learning state, or atlas progress. They never decorate empty space.

rules.name: The One-Anchor Rule
rules.body: Each surface gives priority to one person, place, object, map, phrase, document, or typographic proposition.

rules.name: The Image-Is-Source-Material Rule
rules.body: Image assets contain no copy. Live text is composed into safe negative space or a full-width editorial band and never covers evidence-bearing detail.

rules.name: The Text-Led Equivalence Rule
rules.body: An image-free surface earns the same authorship through type, measure, rhythm, open space, and one clear proposition.

rules.name: The Pressure-Follows-Story Rule
rules.body: Cinematic Atlantic and Storm treatments appear only as historical pressure rises; utility surfaces stay calm and native.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif speaks for story, names, quoted language, and evidence; sans serif speaks for the interface.

rules.name: The Flat-Field Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit in the same physical world until hierarchy or interaction requires separation.

dos: Do make the real person, place, object, document, or surviving trace the visual center of each encounter.
Do keep image assets text-free and compose all copy as live, accessible interface text.
Do give image-free surfaces a deliberate text-led opening and one typographic anchor.
Do reserve cards for discrete interaction, evidence, or objects that need a real boundary.
Do use limestone/shore tonal layering before adding borders or shadows.
Do preserve native iOS navigation, controls, safe areas, touch targets, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, Increased Contrast, and Reduce Motion.
donts: Don't use generic language-app gamification or plastic-shamrock Irishness.
Don't use sticker portraits, decorative leader lines, burned-in labels, or copy squeezed beside an image.
Don't cover faces, objects, inscriptions, or other evidence-bearing detail with text.
Don't cast the learner as a fictional guide, witness, or assistant in undocumented history.
Don't break trusted iOS behavior for interface novelty.
